'''The 1949 Summer Deaflympics''' ({{langx|da|1949 Sommer Deaflympics}}) officially known as the 6th Deaf Olympiad<ref name="Atherton1949Deaflympics">{{cite book |last1=Atherton |first1=Martin |title=Deafness, Community and Culture in Britain: Leisure and Cohesion, 1945–95 |date=2012 |publisher=Oxford University Press |location=Manchester |isbn=9780719084676 |page=18 |url=https://books.google.com/books?id=RZRODwAAQBAJ&pg=PA18 |accessdate=10 January 2019 |language=en}}</ref> ({{langx|da|6. DøveOlympiade}})is an international multi-sport event that was held from 12 August 1949 to 16 August 1949. This event was hosted in [[Copenhagen]], [[Denmark]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.deaflympics.com/games.asp?1949-s|title=Games {{!}} Deaflympics|website=www.deaflympics.com|language=en|access-date=2017-08-30|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20130704092400/http://www.deaflympics.com/games.asp?1949-s|archive-date=2013-07-04 |url-status=dead}}</ref>.This Deaflympics was held after 10 years since the last edition of the Deaflympics(1939) due to [[World War II]].

[[Basketball]] and [[water polo]] were added as events for the first time in [[Deaflympics]] history.

==Participating Countries==
The following countries participated in the 1949 Deaflympics:<ref name="Deaflympics1949Countries">{{cite web |title=Copenhagen 1949 Countries participated |url=https://www.deaflympics.com/games/1949-s |website=Deaflympics.com |publisher=International Committee of Sports for the Deaf |accessdate=7 December 2018}}</ref>

* {{Flagicon|Belgium}}[[Belgium at the Deaflympics|Belgium]]
* {{Flagicon|Czechoslovakia}}[[Czechoslovakia at the Deaflympics|Czechoslovakia]]
* {{Flagicon|Denmark}}[[Denmark at the Deaflympics|Denmark]]
* {{Flagicon|Finland}}[[Finland at the Deaflympics|Finland]]
* {{Flagicon|France}}[[France at the Deaflympics|France]]
* {{Flagicon|Great Britain}}[[Great Britain at the Deaflympics|Great Britain]]
* {{Flagicon|Italy}}[[Italy at the Deaflympics|Italy]]
* {{Flagicon|Netherlands}}[[Netherlands at the Deaflympics|Netherlands]]
* {{Flagicon|Norway}}[[Norway at the Deaflympics|Norway]]
* {{Flagicon|Sweden}}[[Sweden at the Deaflympics|Sweden]]
* {{Flagicon|Switzerland}}[[Switzerland at the Deaflympics|Switzerland]]
* {{Flagicon|United States|1912}}[[United States at the Deaflympics|United States of America]]
* {{Flagicon|Yugoslavia}}[[Yugoslavia at the Deaflympics|Yugoslavia]]
